about: Settings are named as the cloud API and the filters do (`KmsMasterKeyId`), not as one infrastructure tool spells them (`kms_master_key_id`).

controls.output: - SQS queues without a `KmsMasterKeyId` are flagged. Queues with a KMS key set pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:sqs-kms@1
- SQS queues without `kms_master_key_id` are flagged. Queues with a KMS key pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:sqs-kms@1
